name: dado-tools
description: Reusable Claude Code plugins for repository discipline, web quality gates, Python/Windows desktop release work, bilingual content review, and strict release safety.

plugins.name: dado-core
plugins.description: Shared orientation, planning, evidence-first debugging, safe editing and honest verification discipline used by every other dado-tools plugin.

plugins.name: dado-web-quality
plugins.description: Quality gate for websites and web apps: responsive layout, accessibility, routing, SEO metadata, headers, Playwright and Lighthouse interpretation.

plugins.name: dado-python-windows
plugins.description: Review and release workflow for Python desktop applications on Windows: subprocess safety, packaging, installer verification and honest hardware-test reporting.

plugins.name: dado-content-localization
plugins.description: Factual writing, bilingual (EN/ME) synchronization, CV consistency and metadata review with a strict no-invented-claims rule.

plugins.name: dado-release-safety
plugins.description: Strict review, pull request, merge and deployment gates. Stops before merge, release, tag or deploy unless the user gives a task-specific instruction.
